messages.subject: Re: Error in Activity Density
parts:
Hi Alfons,
your question is related to this other question here in the forum: see here

It is because you seem to have species with very few records. If this is a case, then it is not possible to compute activity densities.

I would suggest to split your code into separate commands, because the recordTable function may take a while to run. That way you'd only have to run recordTable once.

species4ActivitySCL <- "SCL"
records <- recordTable(inDir = "D:/TANGKOKO", IDfrom = "directory", timeZone = "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")
activityDensity(records, species = species4Activity)

For activity anayses I'd suggest to remove non-independent records by filtering for temporal independence, e.g. argument minDeltaTime = 60 in the recordTable function. Otherwise you may get biased results if you have long sequences of individuals in front of certain cameras.

Best regards,
Jürgen
